senses.gloss:
r. 6th cl. (कुणति)
1 To sound.
2 To cherish, to support or aid with gifts, &c.
3 To be in pain.
r. 10th cl. (कुणयति)
1 To converse with, to speak to or address.
2 To counsel or advise.

r. 10th cl. (कूणयते-ति)
To contract or close.

mn. (-पः-पी-पं)
Foul smelling, stinking.
mn. (-पः-पं)
1 A dead body, a corpse.
m. (-पः)
1 A stink, a foul smell.
2 A spear.
f. (-पी)
A small bird, a kind of Maina or Sārika: see विट्सारिका.
E.
क्वण to sound, कपन् affix, व is changed to its congener उ; sound proceeding from the corpse, &c. by the escape of the vital air, &c.

m. (-लः)
The name of a country.
E.
क्वण to sound, कालन् Uṇādi affix, व becomes उ.

m. (-णिः)
1 A cripple with a crooked or withered arm, or without a hand or finger; कूणि.
2 The Tūn tree, (Cedrela tunna); also तुणि.
3 A whitlow.
E.
कुण to sound, कि aff.

mfn. (-णिः णिः-णि)
Crooked-armed, having a curved or withered arm: see कुणि.

m. (-न्दः)
Sound, sounding.
E.
क्वण to sound, किन्दच् aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Fat, corpulent.
E.
कुटि to be crooked, क्वन् aff.

mfn. (-ण्ठः-ण्ठा-ण्ठं)
1 Indolent, lazy, slow.
2 Stupid, foolish, a fool.
E.
कुठि to be slothful, &c. affix अच्.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
A fool, stupid, ignorant.
E.
कन् added to the former.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Grasped, held.
2 Encircled.
3 Stupid.
E.
कुठि and क्त aff.

m. (-ण्डः)
A son born in adultery, the son of a woman by another man than her husband, while the husband is alive.
n. (-ण्डं)
1 A hole in the ground for receiving and preserving consecrated fire.
2 A pool, a well, a spring or basin of water, especially consecrated to some holy purpose or person.
2 A measure.
mf. (-ण्डः-ण्डी)
A pitcher.
f. (-ण्डी)
A student's water-pot, made of a hollow cocoanut, &c.
E.
कुडि to preserve, ड aff.

m. (-टः)
1 A follower of the Cārvāka doctrine, or the tenets of those sects who deny the authority of the Vedas.
2 The son of a woman of the Brahminical tribe born in adultery, particularly with a man of an inferior caste.
3 A keeper of concubines, a man who has female slaves.
E.
कुण्ड a pool, &c. and कीट a worm, a reptile.

m. (-लः)
A low, vile man: see नागर.

m. (-लः)
Sour rice gruel.

m. (-कः)
Sour rice gruel: see काञ्जिक.
E.
कुण्ड a pitcher, गुड to preserve, ण्वुल् affix, ड is changed to ल.

m. (-ङ्गः)
An arbour, a bower.
E.
कुडि to preserve, अङ्गच् aff.

m. (-य्यः)
A sacrifice, an oblation.
E.
कुण्ड, and पाय्य to be imbibed.

n. (-लं)
1 An earring.
2 A bracelet.
3 A fetter, a tie, a collar.
f. (-ली)
1 Mountain ebony: see काञ्चन.
2 Gurūci, a plant, (Menispermum glabrum): see गुडूची.
3 Cowach.
E.
कुडि to preserve, कलच् aff.

n. (-णं)
Wearing earrings.
E.
कुण्डल, and धारण having.

mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि)
Wearing earrings.
E.
कुण्डल, and धारिन् who has.

mfn. (-ली-लिनी-लि)
Having an earring.
m. (-ली)
1 A name of VARUṆA regent of the water.
2 A snake.
3 A peacock.
4 The spotted or painted deer.
f. (-नी)
1 A Śakti or form of DURGĀ, worshipped by the Tāntrikas.
2 A plant, (Menispermum glabrum.)
3 Curds boiled with Ghee and spices.
E.
कुण्डल an earring, and इनि affix; the rings on the snake, the eyes in the peacock's tail, &c., being compared to this ornament.

m. (-शी)
1 A pander, a pimp.
2 One who is supported by a bastard.
E.
कुण्ड, अश to eat, and इनि aff.

f. (-का)
1 A student's waterpot, the Kamandalu.
2 A pitcher.
E.
कुण्ड a pitcher, &c. कन् added with the fem. aff.

n. (-नं)
A city; also Vidarbhā, the capital of Vidarbha the father-in-law of Nala Rājā, apparently the modern Condavir.
m. plur. (-नाः)
The people of Kundina.
m. (-नः)
The name of a saint.
E.
कुडि to preserve, इनच् Uṇādi aff.

m. (-ण्डी)
A bastard: see कुण्ड.
E.
कुण्ड and इनि aff.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Able, powerful.
m. (-रः)
A man.

f. (-का)
1 The horn of any animal.
2 The peg of a lute.
E.
कूण to sound or be crooked, वुन् and टाप् affs.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Contracted, shut, closed.
E.
कूण to contract, affix क्त.
